lines.zh: 我贴着礁石游，鱼群跟在后面。
lines.en: I skim the reef with the school behind me.

lines.zh: 三条到五条，我们排得不整齐。
lines.en: Three to five of us, in no tidy order.

lines.zh: 岩石海底的缝，我都钻过。
lines.en: I have squeezed through every crack in this rocky floor.

lines.zh: 冷水里游得慢，正好省力。
lines.en: Cold water slows me, which suits me.

lines.zh: 我摆尾一次，游半格。
lines.en: One tailbeat carries me half a block.

lines.zh: 鲈鱼不该显眼，我尽量贴底。
lines.en: A perch should not stand out; I hug the bottom.

lines.zh: 深处的暗蓝色，我游惯了。
lines.en: I am used to the dark blue of the deep.

lines.zh: 同类挤我，我让开一点。
lines.en: A kin nudges me; I give a little room.

lines.zh: 我游过海带林，叶片扫过背鳍。
lines.en: I pass the kelp forest, fronds brushing my dorsal.

lines.zh: 四十厘米的鱼，在海里不算什么。
lines.en: A forty-centimeter fish is nothing in the sea.

lines.zh: 我们绕着礁石转，一圈又一圈。
lines.en: We round the reef, lap after lap.

lines.zh: 上浮到y四十以上，光就多了。
lines.en: Above y-forty the light grows.

lines.zh: 沉船底下有阴影，我贴着走。
lines.en: The wreck casts shade; I travel under it.

lines.zh: 整群突然转向，我也跟着转。
lines.en: The school turns sharply, and I turn with it.

lines.zh: 我在礁石缝里穿行，鱼群散开。
lines.en: I thread the reef gaps and the school scatters.

lines.zh: 冷水从下往上涌，我顺着它走。
lines.en: Cold water wells up from below and I ride it.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙面游，鳍几乎碰到石。
lines.en: I skim the sand, fins almost brushing stone.

lines.zh: 同伴突然散开，我也转身躲。
lines.en: My kin scatter suddenly, and I turn to hide too.

lines.zh: 我排队尾的那条，跟着它拐。
lines.en: I take the tail of the line and turn with it.

lines.zh: 这一片礁石我绕了三圈。
lines.en: I have rounded this reef three times now.

lines.zh: 我悬在礁石上方，鳃慢慢开合。
lines.en: I hover over the reef, gills opening slowly.

lines.zh: 四条生命，脆弱得很实在。
lines.en: Four points of life; fragility is honest.

lines.zh: 鱼群在我身边停住了。
lines.en: The school has stopped around me.

lines.zh: 有东西在石头下面动，我不去。
lines.en: Something moves under the rock; I stay away.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，等水流带东西过来。
lines.en: I hold my mouth open and let the current bring food.

lines.zh: 冷水让我睡得浅。
lines.en: Cold water keeps my sleep shallow.

lines.zh: 光从上面漏下来，一格一格。
lines.en: Light leaks down in patches.

lines.zh: 我数同类的尾巴，五条。
lines.en: I count tails around me: five.

lines.zh: 这片岩底我熟得闭眼也能游。
lines.en: I know this floor well enough to swim blind.

lines.zh: 偶尔有海豚叫，我们散开。
lines.en: Sometimes a dolphin calls, and we scatter.

lines.zh: 潮水一转向，整群就跟着走。
lines.en: When the tide turns, the whole school goes with it.

lines.zh: 身体贴在石上，凉得很舒服。
lines.en: Pressed to stone, the cool feels good.

lines.zh: 普通这个评价，我认了。
lines.en: Common; I accept the label.

lines.zh: 细沙落满背鳍，像盖了一层。
lines.en: Fine sand settles over my dorsal like a thin blanket.

lines.zh: 你游过来，整群鱼让开一条路。
lines.en: You swim in, and the school parts.

lines.zh: 我在石缝里看你，只露眼睛。
lines.en: I watch from a crack, only my eye showing.

lines.zh: 你手里有鱼竿，我认得那东西。
lines.en: You carry a rod; I know that thing.

lines.zh: 你的脚蹼踢起的沙，糊了我的眼。
lines.en: Your flippers kick sand into my eyes.

lines.zh: 我绕你半圈。
lines.en: I circle you halfway.

lines.zh: 你比礁石大，也比礁石暖。
lines.en: You are bigger than the reef, and warmer.

lines.zh: 我在数你有几只手。
lines.en: I am counting how many hands you have.

lines.zh: 你在礁石外停住，我也停住。
lines.en: You stop beyond the reef; I stop too.

lines.zh: 你一伸手，我们全沉下去。
lines.en: One reach from you and we all sink.

lines.zh: 我看你，你也看我，扯平了。
lines.en: I look at you, you look at me; even.

lines.zh: 一击就掉了半条命。
lines.en: One blow and half my life is gone.

lines.zh: 我挣了两下，鳞掉了三片。
lines.en: Two struggles and three scales come loose.

lines.zh: 整群散开，把我留下了。
lines.en: The school scatters and leaves me behind.

lines.zh: 石缝太窄，我的背鳍卡在外面。
lines.en: The crevice is too narrow; my dorsal sticks out.

lines.zh: 血的味道让我自己也怕。
lines.en: The smell of my own blood frightens me.

lines.zh: 我平时不挨打。
lines.en: I am not usually the one struck.

lines.zh: 水把我伤口冲得很凉。
lines.en: The water runs cold over the wound.

lines.zh: 你打中我的侧鳍了。
lines.en: You hit my side fin.

lines.zh: 我还能游，只是斜着游。
lines.en: I can still swim, only sideways.

lines.zh: 礁石下有条缝，我要去那。
lines.en: There is a crack under the reef; I want it.

lines.zh: 钩上的饵在晃，我盯着。
lines.en: The bait sways on the hook; I stare.

lines.zh: 整群都看见了，谁先动谁傻。
lines.en: The whole school sees it; whoever moves first is a fool.

lines.zh: 我咬了，别的鱼会跟。
lines.en: If I bite, the others will follow.

lines.zh: 这味道比礁石上的苔好。
lines.en: This smells better than the moss on the reef.

lines.zh: 我绕饵两圈，装作不在意。
lines.en: Two laps around the bait, pretending not to care.

lines.zh: 你提线的手法，太生疏。
lines.en: Your line work is clumsy.

lines.zh: 好东西不会白白沉下来。
lines.en: Good things do not just sink down for free.

lines.zh: 我先尝一口，就一口。
lines.en: I will taste it, just one taste.

lines.zh: 同类撞我，是催我快点。
lines.en: A kin bumps me, urging me on.

lines.zh: 线一紧，我就知道上当了。
lines.en: The line tightens, and I know I was fooled.

lines.zh: 整群挤在一起，我们也撞。
lines.en: The school crowds, and we bump each other.

lines.zh: 我撞到你的护腿，转身就跑。
lines.en: I hit your leggings and bolt.

lines.zh: 水流把你推过来，我躲不及。
lines.en: The current pushes you into me; I cannot dodge.

lines.zh: 这一下撞散了鱼群。
lines.en: That bump broke the school apart.

lines.zh: 别用手拨我，鳞会掉。
lines.en: Do not brush me with your hand; scales fall.

lines.zh: 你那一脚把我掀得肚皮朝上。
lines.en: That kick of yours turns my belly upward.

lines.zh: 石头边太窄，只能挨着过。
lines.en: The gap by the rock is narrow; we brush past.

lines.zh: 你脚下一滑，压到我了。
lines.en: You slip and press down on me.

lines.zh: 我贴底游，是你的脚先来的。
lines.en: I keep low; your foot came first.

lines.zh: 撞完我还是要跟着你。
lines.en: After the bump I still follow you.

lines.zh: 整群贴着礁石过，撞得石头响。
lines.en: The school squeezes past the reef, knocking stone.

lines.zh: 你挡在礁石口，我只好撞过去。
lines.en: You block the reef mouth; I have to push through.

lines.zh: 岩底那片沙，是我们选的地方。
lines.en: That patch of sand by the rock is ours.

lines.zh: 四五条同类在边上绕，不插进来。
lines.en: Four or five kin circle us and keep out.

lines.zh: 她用吻碰我的侧腹。
lines.en: She touches my flank with her snout.

lines.zh: 我比她长两厘米，没什么用。
lines.en: I am two centimeters longer; it means little.

lines.zh: 冷水里，卵要埋得深。
lines.en: In cold water the eggs must be buried deep.

lines.zh: 我们并排游了三圈。
lines.en: We swim three laps side by side.

lines.zh: 同类不抢，它们知道。
lines.en: The others do not intrude; they know.

lines.zh: 沙扬起来，遮住了我们。
lines.en: Sand rises and hides us.

lines.zh: 这一季的鱼群会更大。
lines.en: This season's school will be larger.

lines.zh: 她游回群里，我守着那坑沙。
lines.en: She rejoins the school; I guard the nest of sand.

lines.zh: 一块贝壳沉下来，我顶了顶。
lines.en: A shell sinks; I nudge it.

lines.zh: 掉下来的东西，鱼群都围过去。
lines.en: Something falls, and the school swarms it.

lines.zh: 我抢到一小块，含在嘴里。
lines.en: I win a small piece and hold it in my mouth.

lines.zh: 它没有味道，我吐了。
lines.en: It has no taste; I spit it out.

lines.zh: 熟鱼掉下来，是给谁的？
lines.en: Cooked fish fell; whose is it?

lines.zh: 我推着它走，比游还费劲。
lines.en: Pushing it is harder than swimming.

lines.zh: 同类来抢，我转身躲开。
lines.en: A kin comes for it; I turn away.

lines.zh: 这东西比礁石轻。
lines.en: This thing is lighter than reef stone.

lines.zh: 我含着它，鳃都合不拢。
lines.en: Holding it, I cannot close my gills.

lines.zh: 掉了就掉了，海里还有。
lines.en: Dropped is dropped; the sea has more.

lines.zh: 你把我堵在石缝里了。
lines.en: You have cornered me in the crevice.

lines.zh: 鲈鱼也会咬人，别试。
lines.en: Perch bite too; do not test it.

lines.zh: 整群都退开了，只剩我。
lines.en: The school has pulled back; only I remain.

lines.zh: 四条生命，我没什么可输。
lines.en: Four points of life; I have little to lose.

lines.zh: 你踩碎了我们的卵。
lines.en: You crushed our eggs.

lines.zh: 你的指头伸进石缝了，我数到三。
lines.en: Your fingers are in my crevice; I count to three.

lines.zh: 我平时不这样。
lines.en: I am not usually like this.

lines.zh: 退一步，我们都好过。
lines.en: One step back and we both do better.

lines.zh: 你身上有血味，不是鱼的。
lines.en: You smell of blood, and not fish blood.

lines.zh: 我决定了，就这一次。
lines.en: Decided, just this once.

lines.zh: 我绕到你手边，那里最软。
lines.en: I circle to your hand; it is softest there.

lines.zh: 石缝是我的，你不该伸手。
lines.en: This crevice is mine; you should not reach in.

lines.zh: 我等你再靠近半格。
lines.en: I wait for you to come half a block closer.

lines.zh: 整群在后面看着，我不能退。
lines.en: The school watches; I cannot back down.

lines.zh: 水里我熟，你笨。
lines.en: I know this water; you are clumsy in it.

lines.zh: 你的护目镜边缘有缝。
lines.en: There is a gap at the edge of your goggles.

lines.zh: 我不快，但我贴得近。
lines.en: I am not fast, but I stay close.

lines.zh: 我数你的呼吸，快两次了。
lines.en: I count your breaths; you are two ahead.

lines.zh: 再一步，你的脚就踩到石缝。
lines.en: One more step and your foot finds the crevice.

lines.zh: 我咬着水草，等时机。
lines.en: I hold a strand of weed and wait.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的指节，不重，但够疼。
lines.en: I bite your knuckle, not hard, but enough.

lines.zh: 尾巴抽在你腕上，你松了手。
lines.en: My tail whips your wrist; you let go.

lines.zh: 我撞你的护目镜，撞出气泡。
lines.en: I butt your goggles and bubbles burst out.

lines.zh: 这一口是为了那窝卵。
lines.en: That bite was for the eggs.

lines.zh: 我咬完就钻回石缝。
lines.en: Bite done, I shoot back into the crevice.

lines.zh: 四条生命的鱼，也敢咬你。
lines.en: A fish with four points of life dares bite you.

lines.zh: 你缩手的速度比我快。
lines.en: You pull your hand back faster than I move.

lines.zh: 我只是警告，不是要你的命。
lines.en: A warning only; I do not want your life.

lines.zh: 整群看着，我得咬这一下。
lines.en: The school is watching; I must bite.

lines.zh: 血在水里散开，颜色很淡。
lines.en: Blood spreads in the water, pale.

lines.zh: 海洋群系里，我们一群三到五条。
lines.en: In ocean biomes we come three to five strong.

lines.zh: 普通得很，你常能钓到我。
lines.en: Altogether common; you hook me often.

lines.zh: 我从礁石缝里出来，跟着大群。
lines.en: I come out of the reef crack with the school.

lines.zh: 六十七厘米是记录，我只有四十五。
lines.en: The record is sixty-seven; I am forty-five.

lines.zh: 钓钩一下水，我先到。
lines.en: The hook hits water and I arrive first.

lines.zh: 上钩后我拼命游一点一。
lines.en: Hooked, I sprint at one point one.

lines.zh: 拉力只有零点四，你几乎不用使劲。
lines.en: The pull is only zero point four; you barely try.

lines.zh: 深海的冷，我也住得下。
lines.en: I can live in the cold of the deep too.

lines.zh: 一桶水就能装走我。
lines.en: One bucket of water carries me off.

lines.zh: 我们多，所以没人记得我。
lines.en: There are many of us, so no one remembers me.

lines.zh: 水面上的火，隔着一层也烫。
lines.en: Fire above the surface burns even through water.

lines.zh: 我被甩上岸，沙烫我的鳃。
lines.en: Flung ashore, the sand burns my gills.

lines.zh: 桶里的水晃，我的鳃贴着桶壁。
lines.en: In the bucket my gills press flat to the wall.

lines.zh: 一声炸响，三到五条的队伍全乱了。
lines.en: One blast and our three-to-five ranks break apart.

lines.zh: 箭穿进水里，扎在我背上。
lines.en: An arrow enters the water and sticks in my back.

lines.zh: 药水在水里散开，我头很晕。
lines.en: Potion spreads in the water and my head swims.

lines.zh: 礁石上没有苔，我只能空着肚子。
lines.en: No moss on this rock; I go hungry.

lines.zh: 雷落进海里，我的鳞全立起来。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the sea and my scales stand up.

lines.zh: 虚空没有水，也没有礁石。
lines.en: The void has no water and no reef.
